verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a stateless search and answer API. It does not host or run user automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a wrong axis for this kind of product. Its n8n, Dify and MCP integrations only plug the search API into other platforms, which own any automation lifecycle; they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
